name: Matheus Camilo
event: UFC Fight Night: Allen vs. Duncan
summary: A 25-year-old Nova Uniao wrestler: 11-3, about three takedowns per 15 minutes in the UFC. Knocked out Nazim Sadykhov in 91 seconds in June after out-working Viacheslav Borshchev.

how_they_fight.Striking: Low UFC volume (about 1.7 significant strikes a minute) but showed power against Sadykhov.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Wrestling-heavy: chains takedowns and controls; was submitted by Gabriel Green in 2025.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Says he respects Herbert's experience (Yahoo Sports).

sources.title: Matheus Camilo plans to respect Jai Herbert's experience at UFC Vegas 122
